answer_1.quote: We consider three complementary tasks... 1. Random Sentence Task: The model is prompted to generate an open-ended sentence... 2. Repetition Task: In a few-shot setup, the model must repeat a sentence after two example repetitions... 3. Temporal Translation Task: We use a similar few-shot setup where the model must "translate" a sentence into a different tense or aspect.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs include generated sentences in various tenses and aspects, such as "The sun was setting over the ocean..." and "The new policy will require all employees..."

answer_2.quote: We evaluate steering success by giving the generated outputs to the model in a new forward pass without any interventions, extracting their representations and applying the trained probing classifiers... We define the following four performance metrics... relative change in perplexity... degenerate outputs... BERTScore

answer_3.quote: more expensive methods (e.g., LLM-as-a-judge) can be applied for final evaluations after tuning hyperparameters
